stemMd: A wildlife reserve plans to move a walking trail away from nesting sites, predicting fewer nest disturbances without closing the reserve. Which finding most strengthens the prediction?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Most recorded disturbances occur when walkers pass within a short distance of nests, and the proposed route remains outside that distance.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The reserve has a long official name.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Nests are counted once each season.

explanationMd: The evidence identifies a spatial mechanism and shows that the proposed intervention addresses it while allowing continued access elsewhere.

distractorRationale.e: Counting frequency does not show the proposed route reduces contact.
distractorRationale.a: Popularity does not establish whether the new route prevents close approaches.
distractorRationale.d: Naming does not establish disturbance mechanisms.
distractorRationale.b: Camera possession alone does not link the route to disturbances.
